children: Travere Therapeutics named Bradley Campbell as president and chief executive officer, effective Dec. 1.
Campbell's appointment comes as the biopharmaceutical company's president and CEO Eric Dube plans to step down to focus on his health and family, the company said Monday.
Dube will continue to hold his current roles until Campbell's appointment takes effect, and will stay on as an executive adviser through Feb. 15, Travere  said.
Campbell was previously president and CEO of Amicus Therapeutics, which is now a wholly-owned subsidiary of BioMarin Pharmaceutical.
